sloka: उपलैः इव संछन्ना दृश्यते भूः शिल उच्चयैः ।आपगाभिः च संवीता सूत्रैः इव वसुंधरा ॥४-६१-८॥
transliteration: upalaiḥ iva saṁchannā dṛśyate bhūḥ śila uccayaiḥ ।āpagābhiḥ ca saṁvītā sūtraiḥ iva vasuṁdharā ॥4-61-8॥

translations.english: 'The earth filled with lofty mountains appeared as if it is covered with pebbles. Surrounded by rivers meandering, it looked as though it was entwined with threads.
